$comment: Diagnostic addresses for E-series modules. protocol: Ds2 | BmwFast | Obd2. sgbd: EDIABAS group/variant names to try in order (only used in EDIABAS mode). pos: approximate location on the top-view car drawing (1000 x 460, front at left, driver side at bottom). Set verified=true only after reading the module on a real car, and say which model in the pull request (no VIN or personal details). optional: fitted only with certain options (scanned, but a missing answer is normal). partOf: lives inside another module (shown with it on the drawing).

modules.name: Active front steering (AFS)
modules.note: Only with the Active Steering option.

modules.name: Transfer case control (VGSG)
modules.note: Only on xDrive (all-wheel-drive) cars.

modules.name: Tyre pressure control (RDC)
modules.note: Only with direct TPMS. Many E9x use RPA flat-tyre detection inside the DSC instead, which has no separate module.

modules.name: Active cruise control radar (ACC)
modules.note: Only with the Active Cruise Control option.

modules.name: Convertible top module (CVM)
modules.note: Only on the E93 convertible.

modules.name: Passive Go System (PGS)
modules.note: Listed in the E90 group table. A separate unit may not be present on every comfort-access car.

modules.name: Electric power steering (EPS)
modules.note: Listed in the E90 group table. Most E9x have hydraulic steering, so confirm before use.

modules.name: Speech processing / voice recognition (SVS)
modules.note: Only with the voice-control option on CCC cars.

modules.name: Telephone / telematics / Bluetooth (TEL)
modules.note: Only with a phone or BMW Assist option. The group table names it TEL/MULF, and the ZUORDNUNGSTABELLE lists ULF_60 here.

modules.name: Top-HiFi / Logic7 amplifier (AMP)
modules.note: Only with the Top-HiFi option.

modules.name: Rear air suspension / self-levelling (EHC)
modules.note: Listed in the E90 group table. Probably E91 Touring self-levelling only.

modules.name: Electronic damper control (EDC)
modules.note: Probably M3 EDC option only. Listed in the E89X table, not in the early E90 table.

modules.name: Navigation part of CCC (NAV)
modules.note: Only on CCC navigation cars. The ZUORDNUNGSTABELLE lists NAV_60 'im CCC'.

modules.name: CD changer (CDC)
modules.note: Only with the CD changer option.

modules.name: Audio system controller (ASK)
modules.note: Only on CCC cars (ASK_60 'im CCC').

modules.name: Anti-theft alarm (DWA)
modules.note: Listed in the E90 group table. E9x alarms normally use SINE (0x50).

modules.name: Sunroof module (SHD)
modules.note: Listed in the E90 group table. On many E9x the sunroof is driven from the FZD instead.

modules.name: Antenna tuner (ANTTU)
modules.note: Only on CCC cars.

modules.name: Video module (VM)
modules.note: Only with the TV/video option.

modules.name: Alarm siren with tilt sensor (SINE)
modules.note: Only with the alarm option.

modules.name: Satellite radio tuner (SDARS)
modules.note: US/Canada satellite-radio option. The group table calls it RADIO, with SAT_60 'Satellitenradio US'.

modules.name: Digital radio tuner (DAB)
modules.note: Only with the digital tuner option. The E89X table also lists IBOC at 0x53, so the US HD Radio address is uncertain.

modules.name: MOST/CAN gateway (MOSTGW)
modules.note: Logical gateway inside the head unit.

modules.name: iDrive controller (ZBE)
modules.note: Only on iDrive (navigation) cars.

modules.name: Driver seat memory module (SMFA)
modules.note: Only with memory seats. The group table names it FAS.

modules.name: Passenger seat module (SMBF)
modules.note: Only with passenger memory/power seats. The group table names it BFS.

modules.name: Trailer module (AHM)
modules.note: Only with a factory tow hitch.

modules.name: Central information display (CID)
modules.note: Only with CCC/CIC navigation.

modules.name: Auxiliary / parking heater (SHZH)
modules.note: Only with the park heater option (mainly diesels and Europe).

modules.name: CCC application processor (CCCA)
modules.note: Only on CCC cars.

modules.name: Sunroof module (SHD)
modules.note: Only with a sunroof.

modules.name: CD changer (CDC)
modules.note: Only with the CD changer option.

modules.name: Steering angle sensor (LWS)
modules.note: Probably only with DSC. The source does not tie this address to the E46.

modules.name: Digital sound processor amplifier (DSP)
modules.note: Only with the DSP/HiFi option.

modules.name: Navigation computer (NAV)
modules.note: Only with navigation.

modules.name: Convertible top module (CVM)
modules.note: Only on the convertible. wilhelm-docs lists CVM at both 0x9B and 0x9C, so treat as unconfirmed.

modules.name: Multi-information display (MID)
modules.note: Only on some models with the MID head unit.

modules.name: Telephone (TEL)
modules.note: Only with the phone option.

modules.name: Video module (VM)
modules.note: Only with the TV/video option.

modules.name: Board monitor control panel (BMBT)
modules.note: Only with the navigation board monitor.
